subject: Intermittent high-latency affecting streaming/chat endpoints — temporary client mitigations and next steps
messages:
From: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@fastretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 09:12:07 -0700
Subject: Re: [Redwood] Intermittent latency observed in live chat

Hi Kimberly,

We're seeing intermittent high tail latency on the streaming/chat endpoint (our checkout assistant) starting ~09:00 PT. Users report long pauses between message tokens and occasional complete stalls for 6-8s. This is impacting conversion on a small segment (~2% traffic).

We've not changed client config today. Attached is a short snippet of our request IDs and sample timestamps. Can you confirm if anything is happening on Redwood's side?

- Aisha
Aisha Kumar
Director, Platform Ops | FastRetail
ops+prod@fastretail.com

Attachment: sample-reqids.txt

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 09:28:52 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Redwood] Intermittent latency observed in live chat

Hi Aisha — thank you for the report and the example request IDs, and I'm sorry for the disruption.

Short status: our telemetry is showing elevated p95/p99 latency on streaming token emission for US-west edges starting ~08:55 PT with occasional microbursts. We're actively investigating; Marissa and Sean are looped in.

Immediate mitigation (short-term, client-side) we recommend while we troubleshoot:
- Enable SDK fallback routing to a compatibility model variant ("redwood-small-llm-latency") for non-critical sessions. This reduces per-token compute.
- Reduce concurrent open streams per user from 6->3 for 2 hours to limit queuing.
- Apply token chunking: set max_tokens_per_chunk=32 (temporary) so clients process smaller token batches and surface partial results quicker.
- If you can, switch streaming connection keepalive to 15s (from default 60s) to detect and recover stale sockets faster.

We're attaching a short FAQ for incidents and we will follow up with a more detailed internal postmortem and a recovery timestamp. We'll also provide a temporary credit offset for impact — discussing with Billing.

I'll coordinate and send you one consolidated set of steps to apply. Let me know if you want Redwood to apply any of the routing toggles on your behalf (requires service change approval).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: incident-FAQ.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 10:03:14 -07:00
Subject: RE: [Redwood] Intermittent latency observed in live chat

Kim / Sean — quick infra notes from the ops team after looking at the probe and edge traces: 
- Cause signal: short-lived queueing at the us-west-2 surface layer tied to a microburst of large-context gen requests (one shard also reported slow kernel handoff). No controller-level deploys at the time.
- Impact: p95 token emission increased from ~120ms->750ms for ~20m windows; p99 saw spikes to ~2.2s.

Immediate platform-side mitigations we can do now: 
1) Toggle routing policy for FastRetail to prefer the "latency-optimized" model family (reduces backend tail) — low risk.
2) Apply temporary per-customer concurrency cap in the edge proxy (60s window) for traffic shaping.
3) Kick a rolling swap of the affected shard to a warmed pool (takes ~8-12m).

I've attached the prod graphs and a short troubleshooting checklist. If Kimberly wants us to own the routing toggle and proxy cap, we can do it with your approval — I'll coordinate with Infra and publish the change window.

Marissa Cole
Principal Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: prod-latency-graphs-20251014.png, troubleshooting-checklist.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 13:02:11 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Redwood] Intermittent latency observed in live chat — actions we took and client steps

On Tue, Oct 14, 2025 at 09:12 AM Aisha Kumar <aisha.k@fastretail.com> wrote:
> We're seeing intermittent high tail latency on the streaming/chat endpoint (our checkout assistant) starting ~09:00 PT. Users report long pauses between message tokens and occasional complete stalls for 6-8s. This is impacting conversion on a small segment (~2% traffic).

Thanks again for the quick heads up, Aisha. We pushed the following changes at 12:45 PT after your confirmation:
- Enabled the routing preference to the latency-optimized model family for FastRetail (non-breaking).
- Applied a transient per-customer concurrency cap at the edge proxy (60s sliding window) to reduce queuing.
- Warmed and rotated the affected shard pool; kernel handoff delays reduced across the board.

On your side, please apply these client steps (we attached a one-click checklist):
1) Set max_tokens_per_chunk=32 in your streaming config (SDK param).
2) Reduce concurrent streams per user to 3 for the next 3 hours.
3) Update SDK to v1.2.3 that includes improved socket reconnect behavior (stop-gap until we ship a runtime fix). Link: https://sdk.redwood.com/releases/1.2.3

Expected outcome: these changes should bring p95 token emission back toward baseline within ~15-30 minutes. We'll keep monitoring and provide postmortem later today with root cause, mitigation timeline, and a proposed permanent fix (likely kernel/queue scheduling tweak + additional warm pool capacity).

Apologies for the disruption — our team will follow up with a postmortem and credit offer for the impacted window. If you'd like Redwood to perform the SDK parameter changes on your behalf, we can schedule a quick ops runbook session.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
